fixes.explanation: That's right, baker! Ten chiefs, “…one family leader from each tribe of Israel, each the head of a family among the clans of Israel.” And Phinehas, son of Eleazar the priest, walks right alongside them. When ten family heads show up at your door together, nobody's asking if you want to talk. They're telling you it's time to talk.
